displayName: UE4 skinned shadow-depth caster vertex family
description: Vertex family that loads buffered bone transforms, blends four or eight influences, transforms the skinned position, and emits ShadowDepth plus SV_POSITION for shadow-map rasterization.

checks.meaning: The DXBC output signature explicitly contains the ShadowDepth semantic.
One float4 buffer supplies packed bone transform rows.
Four packed bone indices are scaled to float4 transform-row offsets; eight-weight variants repeat the operation.
At least four influences load three transform rows each; eight-weight variants load twenty-four rows.
Loaded bone rows are weighted by vertex influence components.
Weighted transform rows are accumulated across the influence set.
The rasterizer position is emitted once.
This is the vertex caster stage, not the later pixel depth writer.

runtimeContract.controlSafety: Caster transforms are structurally distinct from receiver-side shadow evaluation. Never inject screen-space contact-ray code into this family.
